newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises canada oil prices - 8/11.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises canada oil prices - 8/11.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, to C$192.00/cubic metre or C$30.53/barrel, effective immediately.

Other new prices were listed as follows: Cromer light sour C$185.00/cubic metre, or C$29.41/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$156.00/cubic metre, or C$24.80/barrel Midale at Cromer C$162.00/cubic metre, or C$25.76/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
